_doc: One row per client release, append-only: a released row never mutates; a correction appends a superseding row naming what it corrects in notes. node_min is the oldest node this release degrades GRACEFULLY against — every absent capability renders an explained state, not an error. Validated by compat/validate.py (CI) and the compat-matrix readiness gate. FSD/ONE_CLIENT_N_NODES.md §6.

rows.node_min_reason: the three-state /v1/system/health merge (folded brain, CIRISServer#390); older nodes lack data.agent.* and still parse, but chat/contacts absence pre-0.5.185 is explained by the contacts_node_too_old strings, and pre-0.5.168 brain detection degrades to the two-state probe
rows.capabilities_note: surface ids shipped and node-version-dependent at this release; the full capability registry (FSD §4.1) supersedes this list when it lands

spec_source.note: the node serves no OpenAPI spec yet — evidence/blocked_upstream.tsv; nulls retire when FSD §5 lands

rows.notes: seed row, written at the three-way merge (client/VENDORING.md §1)

rows.node_min_reason: unchanged from 0.5.185: the three-state health merge is the floor; contacts/chat absence on older nodes renders the contacts_node_too_old strings
rows.capabilities_note: chat/contacts now in a TAGGED server release (v0.5.186; landed 0.5.185); the 13 status.llm_* strings (incl. _observer variants) ship from agent v2.9.30; ONE build ships (agent surfaces present, gated at runtime on the probed node) — the node/agent split retired

spec_source.note: CIRISServer#470 open — nulls retire when the node serves its spec

rows.notes: the superset merge: server v0.5.186 (1ea2c8b) + agent v2.9.32-stable (2504960) folded into the tree of record; two upstream placeholder defects repaired via the localize pipeline; androidApp ciris-server pin at 0.5.186 (wheels published)

rows.node_min_reason: unchanged from 0.5.186: the three-state health merge (data.agent.{folded,reachable}, CIRISServer#390) is still the floor. This release ADDS a reader for data.role (CIRISAgent#1111) and does not raise the floor with it — role is optional on the wire and its absence falls through to the existing inference, so a 0.5.168 node behaves exactly as before
rows.capabilities_note: no new capability id; two behaviour changes worth naming. (1) SEVERITY: the node's warning vocabulary is info|warning|error|critical and the banner handled three of four, so critical fell through to the blue informational branch — the >=90% memory warning that precedes a SIGKILL rendered LESS urgent than the 80% advisory. Fixed (CIRISClient#2); against a node older than 0.5.188 nothing changes, because nothing emitted critical before it. (2) MODE: the agent surfaces are chosen at runtime from the probed ClientMode, now including the runtime's own data.role declaration. CIRISBuild.HAS_AGENT is DELETED (CIRISServer#479) — one build ships and narrows itself

spec_source.note: CIRISServer#470 open — nulls retire when the node serves its spec

rows.notes: the superset merge: server v0.5.188 (1b4f377) + agent v2.9.36-stable (c211a9f) folded into the tree of record. androidApp ciris-server pin at 0.5.188 (published). The localization guard stops declaring the emitters absent and is pointed at a pinned CIRISServer checkout instead, so its five server-id checks grade 303 emitted ids rather than none; the KNOWN_UNLOCALIZED debt list is exactly current at 19 entries. localize.py becomes a translate->evaluate->repair pipeline with the 29 CIRIS glossaries as input
